format: ECG FPGA INT8 parameter/quantization contract v1
status: reference export; verify arithmetic and rounding against RTL/HLS simulation

integer_convention.weights: signed int8, per-output-channel symmetric (zero point expected 0)
integer_convention.activations: affine uint8 for this PyTorch x86 PTQ calibration
integer_convention.accumulator: int32 MAC; bias exported as int32 in input_scale * weight_scale units
integer_convention.requantization: accumulator * input_scale * weight_scale / output_scale, then add output_zero_point and saturate
integer_convention.rounding: bias uses NumPy round-to-nearest-even; RTL must match or compare and adjust

limitations: Quantized convolution operator ordering/padding must match PyTorch semantics.
Residual add requantization and global average pooling need bit-accurate verification.
This contract is not a bitstream and does not establish FPGA timing or resource use.
